weapon.d: Grants Spd+3. At start of turn, if unit's HP = 100% and unit is within 2 spaces of an ally, deals 1 damage to unit and allies within 2 spaces of unit. If unit's HP < 100% at start of combat, grants Atk/Spd+6 to unit during combat and reduces damage from foe's first attack by 30%.

special.d: Treats foe's Def/Res as if reduced by 30% during combat.
Treats foe's Def/Res as if reduced by 30% during combat.

a.d: If unit is not adjacent to an ally, grants Atk/Spd+2 during combat.
If unit is not adjacent to an ally, grants Atk/Spd+4 during combat.
If unit is not adjacent to an ally, grants Atk/Spd+6 during combat.
If unit is not adjacent to an ally, grants Atk/Spd+7 during combat.

b.d: Inflicts Spd/Res-1 on foe and neutralizes foe's bonuses to Spd/Res (from skills like Fortify, Rally, etc.) during combat.
Inflicts Spd/Res-2 on foe and neutralizes foe's bonuses to Spd/Res (from skills like Fortify, Rally, etc.) during combat.
Inflicts Spd/Res-3 on foe and neutralizes foe's bonuses to Spd/Res (from skills like Fortify, Rally, etc.) during combat.

c.d: At start of turn, if unit is not adjacent to an ally, grants Atk/Spd+2 to unit for 1 turn.
At start of turn, if unit is not adjacent to an ally, grants Atk/Spd+4 to unit for 1 turn.
At start of turn, if unit is not adjacent to an ally, grants Atk/Spd+6 to unit for 1 turn.
